body: Orchestrator integration note (acceptance round): `src/core/plan/graph.ts` imported `RepositoryEntry` from `src/core/repo/portable.ts`. The renderer imports graph.ts (`groupIntoRows`), so the web TypeScript program pulled in portable.ts and, through it, schemas, ids and the database module; `npm run deadcode` then reported ~140 findings. The orchestrator replaced the import with a local structural `RepositoryRef { name; missing? }` in commit 7aa7c70 (no behaviour change).
